domains.name: Islamic Finance and Banking
domains.description: A legal domain focused on financial and banking practices governed by Islamic principles, including Shariah-compliant instruments, risk management in Islamic banking, and mortgage structures adhering to Islamic law.
inclusion_criteria: Islamic banking operations and risk management
Financial market practices under Islamic law
Corporate finance theories applied to Islamic banking
exclusion_criteria: Conventional banking practices not aligned with Shariah
General corporate finance without Islamic legal context
Documents focusing on pure mathematical finance or asymptotic analysis
Non-financial legal domains (e.g., civil law, criminal law)

domains.name: Pakistan Government Regulatory Legislation
domains.description: Legal documents enacted by Pakistani governmental authorities to regulate economic, financial, and labor sectors, including acts, ordinances, and regulations. Focuses on statutory frameworks governing industries, trade, and public services.
inclusion_criteria: Legal documents issued by Pakistani government bodies (e.g., acts, ordinances, regulations)
Documents governing economic, financial, or labor regulations
References to Pakistani authorities (e.g., commissions, boards, federal agencies)
Provisions related to industry-specific rules (e.g., banking, ports, competition law)
exclusion_criteria: Documents not specific to Pakistan (e.g., international treaties, foreign legislation)
Non-regulatory documents (e.g., corporate policies, private contracts)
Religious or cultural laws (e.g., halal certification, Islamic jurisprudence)
General administrative guidelines without legislative force

domains.name: Islamic Jurisprudence
domains.description: A domain encompassing Islamic legal thought, principles, and texts including Shariah law, Qur'anic interpretations, and jurisprudential discussions on criminal, ethical, and social law within Islamic tradition.
inclusion_criteria: Islamic legal texts (e.g., Qur'an, Hadith, Shariah)
Themes in Islamic law (e.g., crime, punishment, bioethics)
Religious literature focused on Islamic legal doctrine
Scholarly analyses of Islamic legal history and theory
exclusion_criteria: General religious studies not focused on law
Non-Islamic religious legal systems (e.g., Jewish, Christian)
Secular legal frameworks or modern civil law
Historical or cultural texts without legal content

other_bucket.name: Other / Uncertain
other_bucket.description: Documents that did not clearly belong to any of the top discovered domains -- either HDBSCAN noise (no dense enough neighborhood) or members of a smaller cluster below the top-N cutoff. Needs human review before being split out into real domains or left as a permanent catch-all.
